definitions.explanation: A person traveling on a vehicle such as a train, airplane, or ship. A formal term used in transportation and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {旅客|りょかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{搭乗|とうじょう}→搭乗：06200_toujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}っている→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: The passengers are waiting to board.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{旅客|りょかく}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of passengers on this route is increasing year by year.

examples.japanese: {旅客|りょかく}⟦ターミナル→ターミナル：11037_taaminaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改修|かいしゅう}→改修：12924_kaishuu⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: Renovation work on the passenger terminal is scheduled to begin next month.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written-register word used mainly in transportation contexts. Everyday conversation would use ⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧ (passenger) or ⟦お{客|きゃく}さん→お客さん：10253_okyakusan⟧ instead. Often appears as a compound modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{旅客機|りょかくき}→旅客機：17838_ryokakuki⟧: passenger aircraft
- {旅客|りょかく}⟦ターミナル→ターミナル：11037_taaminaru⟧: passenger terminal
- {旅客船|りょかくせん}: passenger ship
- {旅客|りょかく}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: number of passengers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧: passenger (general, everyday)
- ⟦{旅行者|りょこうしゃ}→旅行者：22927_ryokousha⟧: traveler (person on a trip)
- ⟦{搭乗者|とうじょうしゃ}→搭乗者：24612_toujousha⟧: person boarding (aircraft)
